title: The Three Widths of God
long_title: The Three Widths of God, The Three Widths of Love, The Three Widths of Being
base_body: And each one cried out to each other, saying this: HOLY, HOLY, HOLY, is Yahweh of Armies, The glory of HIM / His GLORY is filling / is-the-fullness of the seen realm (the earth)
